items.text: CEO Paul Shoukry contrasted Raymond James' approach: it attracts and retains advisors with unique culture, leading service and robust platform, whereas many competitors compete with the largest check; and it values independence, whereas many competitors change comp plans every year to cross-sell bank products.
items.quote: We attract and retain financial advisors with our unique culture, leading service, and robust platform, whereas many of our competitors compete with the largest check. We value independence to foster an environment where our advisors can provide objective advice to their clients, whereas many of our competitors change their comp plans every year to cross-sell more bank products.

items.text: CEO Paul Shoukry said Raymond James has the largest addressable market because it offers all affiliation options and is agnostic about how advisors affiliate, and very few firms treat advisers like clients anymore.
items.quote: we have the largest addressable market in the industry because we have all the affiliation options that an adviser could possibly want... very few firms in the industry that treat advisers like clients anymore.

items.text: CEO Paul Shoukry said competitors with similar cultures have technology investment that is a fraction of Raymond James' roughly $1 billion, making it hard for them to remain competitive on AI and tools.
items.quote: a lot of our competitors who also are focused on personal relationships, and that have similar cultures, their technology investment, for example, is a fraction of ours.

items.text: CEO Paul Shoukry said Raymond James treats recruiting as a long-term marathon and does not dial it up or down quarter by quarter, unlike other firms that lean into recruiting quarter by quarter, which he called unsustainable.
items.quote: when I hear other firms talk about, 'Oh, we think next quarter we're going to lean into recruiting and put a little bit more money into it,' it's like, well, that's not sustainable long-term recruiting.

items.text: CEO Paul Shoukry said Raymond James wants to use AI to empower advisors to better serve clients, whereas many competitors have used technology and plan to use AI to go around advisors and directly to clients.
items.quote: whereas we're really wanting to use AI to help our financial professionals and our financial advisors better serve their clients, where many of our competitors have used technology and are planning on using AI to essentially try to get around their financial advisors to go direct to their clients.

items.text: CEO Paul Shoukry said Raymond James focuses on sustainable growth and quality over quantity with a strong balance sheet, whereas many competitors focus on growth at all costs and have significantly higher leverage.
items.quote: We are focused on sustainable growth and quality over quantity, whereas many of our competitors are focused on growth at all costs. We strive to maintain a strong balance sheet with strong levels of capital and liquidity, whereas many of our competitors have significantly higher levels of leverage.
